main.description: Keyed self. Each field stands in for the same one of the account's app.bsky.actor.profile, field by field: one left out shows the Bluesky profile's, so an account with no such record shows as its Bluesky profile says.

avatar.description: The account's picture. Served by readers from the account's PDS, since no Bluesky record names it.

bot.description: Whether the account is automated, such as a runner, a triager or a reviewer, as it says of itself. Readers leave out of feeds what it says and pushes, and may mark it as a bot. Absent when it is not.

description.description: Free text about the account: its bio.

displayName.description: The name shown over the account's handle.

links.description: Links shown on the profile, in display order. Stands in for the Bluesky profile's links, or, with none, its website.

description: How an account shows on knotless, where that differs from its Bluesky profile.
